mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offline_package_manifest WHERE id = CAST(#{manifestId} AS UUID)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offline_package_manifest WHERE incident_id = CAST(#{incidentId} AS UUID) AND manifest_hash <> #{purgedManifestHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO offline_package_manifest ( id, incident_id, manifest_version, operational_period_id, overall_search_area_id, overall_search_area_version, manifest_hash, manifest_format_version, manifest_payload, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{manifestId} AS UUID), CAST(#{incidentId} AS UUID), #{manifestVersion}, CAST(#{operationalPeriodId} AS UUID), CAST(#{overallSearchAreaId} AS UUID), 1, '1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111', 1, '{}', #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM offline_package_installation WHERE offline_package_manifest_id = CAST(#{manifestId} AS UUID) AND police_phone_id = CAST(#{policePhoneId} AS UUID)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO offline_package_installation ( id, offline_package_manifest_id, police_phone_id, last_reported_by_account_id, status, total_item_count, completed_item_count, failed_item_count, failed_item_keys, last_error_code, last_reported_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{record.id} AS UUID), CAST(#{record.manifestId} AS UUID), CAST(#{record.policePhoneId} AS UUID), CAST(#{record.lastReportedByAccountId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS UUID), #{record.status}, #{record.totalItemCount}, #{record.completedItemCount}, #{record.failedItemCount}, #{record.failedItemKeys, typeHandler=com.surimap.config.mybatis.StringListArrayTypeHandler}, #{record.lastErrorCode}, #{record.lastReportedAt}, #{record.version}, #{record.createdAt}, #{record.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offline_package_installation WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS UUID)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offline_package_installation WHERE offline_package_manifest_id = CAST(#{manifestId} AS UUID) AND status <> 'PURGED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offline_package_installation WHERE offline_package_manifest_id = CAST(#{manifestId} AS UUID) AND status = 'PURGED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offline_package_installation i JOIN offline_package_manifest m ON m.id = i.offline_package_manifest_id WHERE m.incident_id = CAST(#{incidentId} AS UUID) AND ( i.status <> 'PURGED' OR i.total_item_count <> 0 OR i.completed_item_count <> 0 OR i.failed_item_count <> 0 OR i.failed_item_keys IS NOT NULL OR i.last_error_code IS NOT NULL OR i.last_reported_by_account_id IS NOT NULL )
SELECT id FROM offline_package_installation WHERE offline_package_manifest_id = CAST(#{manifestId} AS UUID) AND status IN ('READY', 'PARTIAL', 'DOWNLOADING') ORDER BY police_phone_id

SELECT id, incident_id, manifest_version, overall_search_area_id, overall_search_area_version, manifest_hash, expires_at FROM offline_package_manifest WHERE incident_id = CAST(#{incidentId} AS UUID) ORDER BY manifest_version DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO offline_package_manifest ( id, incident_id, manifest_version, operational_period_id, overall_search_area_id, overall_search_area_version, manifest_hash, manifest_format_version, manifest_payload, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT CAST(#{newManifestId} AS UUID), incident_id, #{manifestVersion}, operational_period_id, CAST(#{overallSearchAreaId} AS UUID), #{overallSearchAreaVersion}, #{manifestHash}, manifest_format_version, manifest_payload, expires_at, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} FROM offline_package_manifest WHERE id = CAST(#{sourceManifestId} AS UUID)
mapper.update: UPDATE offline_package_installation SET status = 'STALE', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE offline_package_manifest_id = CAST(#{sourceManifestId} AS UUID) AND status IN ('READY', 'PARTIAL', 'DOWNLOADING')
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.offline_package_manifest_id, m.incident_id, i.police_phone_id, i.last_reported_by_account_id, i.status, i.total_item_count, i.completed_item_count, i.failed_item_count, i.failed_item_keys, i.last_error_code, i.last_reported_at, i.version, 901 AS sequence_number, i.status = 'READY' AS ready_for_offline_use, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM offline_package_installation i JOIN offline_package_manifest m ON m.id = i.offline_package_manifest_id WHERE i.offline_package_manifest_id = CAST(#{manifestId} AS UUID) AND i.police_phone_id = CAST(#{policePhoneId} AS UUID)

SELECT i.id, m.incident_id, i.police_phone_id, pp.phone_code AS police_phone_code, pp.display_name AS police_phone_name, i.status, i.version, 901 AS sequence_number, m.manifest_version, m.manifest_version AS active_manifest_version, i.status = 'READY' AS ready_for_offline_use FROM offline_package_installation i JOIN offline_package_manifest m ON m.id = i.offline_package_manifest_id LEFT JOIN police_phone pp ON pp.id = i.police_phone_id WHERE i.offline_package_manifest_id = CAST(#{manifestId} AS UUID) ORDER BY i.police_phone_id

SELECT i.id, m.incident_id, i.police_phone_id, pp.phone_code AS police_phone_code, pp.display_name AS police_phone_name, i.status, i.version, 901 AS sequence_number, m.manifest_version, #{activeManifestVersion} AS active_manifest_version, i.status = 'READY' AS ready_for_offline_use FROM offline_package_installation i JOIN offline_package_manifest m ON m.id = i.offline_package_manifest_id LEFT JOIN police_phone pp ON pp.id = i.police_phone_id WHERE i.id IN
CAST(#{id} AS UUID)
ORDER BY i.police_phone_id

WITH latest_manifest AS ( SELECT incident_id, MAX(manifest_version) AS active_manifest_version FROM offline_package_manifest WHERE incident_id = CAST(#{incidentId} AS UUID) GROUP BY incident_id ) SELECT i.id, m.incident_id, i.police_phone_id, pp.phone_code AS police_phone_code, pp.display_name AS police_phone_name, i.status, i.version, 901 AS sequence_number, m.manifest_version, latest_manifest.active_manifest_version, i.status = 'READY' AS ready_for_offline_use FROM offline_package_installation i JOIN offline_package_manifest m ON m.id = i.offline_package_manifest_id JOIN latest_manifest ON latest_manifest.incident_id = m.incident_id LEFT JOIN police_phone pp ON pp.id = i.police_phone_id WHERE m.incident_id = CAST(#{incidentId} AS UUID) ORDER BY CASE i.status WHEN 'READY' THEN 1 WHEN 'PARTIAL' THEN 2 WHEN 'STALE' THEN 3 WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, i.police_phone_id
mapper.update: UPDATE offline_package_installation SET status = 'PURGED', total_item_count = 0, completed_item_count = 0, failed_item_count = 0, failed_item_keys = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_reported_by_account_id = NULL, last_reported_at = NULL, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE offline_package_manifest_id IN ( SELECT id FROM offline_package_manifest WHERE incident_id = CAST(#{incidentId} AS UUID) ) AND ( status <> 'PURGED' OR total_item_count <> 0 OR completed_item_count <> 0 OR failed_item_count <> 0 OR failed_item_keys IS NOT NULL OR last_error_code IS NOT NULL OR last_reported_by_account_id IS NOT NULL )

UPDATE offline_package_manifest SET manifest_hash = #{purgedManifestHash}, manifest_payload = '{"purged":true,"reason":"package_purged","packageItems":[]}', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE incident_id = CAST(#{incidentId} AS UUID) AND manifest_hash <> #{purgedManifestHash}
